title: About language targeting
measures: Language targeting reaches people based on languages they understand; on Search, Google uses the search-term language, user language settings and preferences. Starting September 2026 the campaign-level language setting is removed for Search campaigns and search ads match on the language of the ads; prioritises ads matching the search-term language.
limitations: Help page describing a change in progress on the retrieval date; Google may revise it.

title: Observation: sample of 4 El Paso dental practice websites
measures: research/local/texas-el-paso-practices.md — observable homepage features (booking path, hours, stated languages, insurance and payment information, location content) on 4 practice or group-location websites found with WebSearch on 2026-11-08.
limitations: Small, non-random convenience sample on one date; describes websites, not practice performance, demand or revenue. Sites that blocked automated access were skipped, not worked around. The URL is a representative query link; results were gathered with the WebSearch tool and the sites observed are listed only in the research file. Original search reference: https://www.bing.com/search?q=dentist+El+Paso+TX.

title: Observation: El Paso dental marketing agency pages
measures: research/competitors/texas-el-paso-agencies.md — positioning, services, proof, offers and unanswered questions on 4 agency or vendor pages found with WebSearch queries 'dental marketing agency El Paso' and 'dental SEO El Paso' on 2026-11-08.
limitations: WebSearch returns an unordered list, not a Google ranking; no ads, map packs or AI citations were observable. Vendor claims were not verified. Agencies are not named on public pages. Original search reference: https://www.bing.com/search?q=dental+marketing+agency+El+Paso+TX.
